canvases.description: Tracks this repo's maps, build parents and tickets from GitHub Issues, with lanes, blockers, a next-up pick and session hand-off.

repo.description: Optional owner/name override; defaults to the git origin remote.

parent.description: Optional parent issue number, or "inbox", to show first.

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Re-fetch issues from GitHub, bypassing the 60 second cache, and return the board state.

actions.name: get_state
actions.description: Return the current board state (cached up to 60 seconds).

actions.name: select_parent
actions.description: Show the board for a parent issue number or the Inbox.

actions.name: start_session
actions.description: Hand a ready-for-agent ticket to a new Copilot session (local by default). Does not change labels or assignees.
